title: Tether advertising commitment remained active while the fixed-price GPU customer agreement was cancelled at closing
summary: The 2025 10-K records a $100 million advertising commitment and an expected $150 million GPU-services commitment; the June 17 closing filing states the contemplated fixed-price GPU agreement was not entered because of market conditions and Northern Data utilization.

evidence.observation: The 10-K records a two-year $100 million advertising commitment and contemplated GPU-services commitment.
The closing 8-K states the contemplated fixed-price GPU customer agreement was not entered.

provenance.method: free-range five-role primary-source review and bounded graph synthesis

data.claim: Tether’s two-year $100 million Rumble advertising commitment remained a documented commercial relationship, but the fixed-price GPU customer agreement contemplated for the Northern Data transaction was not entered at closing. Earlier descriptions of a firm $150 million post-closing GPU commitment must therefore be time-bounded and updated.

object.reason_stated: favorable market conditions and Northern Data near-capacity GPU utilization

data.adjudication: Supersedes any interpretation that the contemplated fixed-price GPU agreement necessarily became effective at closing.
